reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: YiB CA - MFO Arnur Credit Loan I

description.narrative: The provision of a senior unsecured loan of up to US$ 2.0m (€1.8m) in KZT equivalent to Arnur Credit ("AC") - a private microfinance organisation based in Kazakhstan. The loan will be provided in two equal tranches of up to US$ 1m each The loan will be provided under the Youth in Business Financing Programme for Central Asia ("YiBP CA", "Programme"), which will be rolled into a blended finance programme under the Financial intermediaries Framework ("FIF"). The aim of the loan is to (i) launch a new product encompassing both financing and NFS targeted at young entrepreneurs, which will increase their access to finance and skills in the economy; (ii) diversify AC's funding base; (iii) enhance AC's product range via new digital sales channels.
